falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,200 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 low (4,216) would invalidate the 77% bottom pattern match, as the prior bottom held; this would signal continuation lower, not basing

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom saw VIX peak at 38.57 but not sustain; sustained elevated fear would indicate systemic stress beyond the prior pattern, invalidating the bottom formation signal

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury spread inverts more than -50 basis points (deeper inversion)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom coincided with spread normalization toward zero; a deepening inversion would signal deteriorating growth expectations, contradicting the cyclical bottom thesis

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
